entities.summary: Thiền Buddhism is the name for the Vietnamese school of Zen Buddhism. Thiền is the Sino-Vietnamese pronunciation of the Middle Chinese word 禪 (chán), an abbreviation of 禪那, which is a transliteration of the Sanskrit word dhyāna ("meditation").
